profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at Hyland
profile.summary:
•	Highly motivated and self-starting individual with more than 20 years experience in software development.
•	Thorough knowledge of development cycle including analysis techniques, system design, development, testing and maintenance for web-based client/server systems using both waterfall and agile development methodology.
•	Proficient in designing and building solutions focusing on user experience, security, performance, structure, and code reuse.
•	Working well with cross-functional teams and customers for gathering requirements, collaborating and driving solutions to completion on-time, within budget without sacrificing quality.
•	Excellent in analysis and deliver innovative solutions in integration and customer escalations.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Business was acquired from Allscripts in April 2018. 

Responsible for android development of mobile enabler in content management application.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for design, development and maintenance of digital document systems for health care provider.
•	Responsible for product life cycle including software requirements, system analysis, coding, testing and maintenance.
•	Responsible to determine the causes and provide solutions for customer escalations and issues.
•	Using both waterfall and agile development methodology.
•	Serve as build master to provide daily support for development team.
•	Assisting and mentoring team members.
•	Developed web application using HTML5, Extjs, Javascript, REST and SOAP web services with java.
•	Design and implement integration layers using REST and SOAP web services to interact with other systems.
•	Design and implement back-end services using java.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for design, development and maintenance of medical document imaging systems for health care throughout multiple product generations. 
•	Responsible for product life cycle including software requirements, system analysis, coding, testing and maintenance.
•	Responsible to determine the causes and provide solutions for customer escalations and issues.
•	Using both waterfall and agile development methodology.
•	Serve as build master to provide daily build support for development team.
•	 Assisting and mentoring  team members.
•	 Developed document imaging viewer applets using JFC/Swing components.
•	 Developed web application using Extjs, Javascript, REST and SOAP web services with java.
•	 Design and implement integration layers using REST and SOAP web services to interact with other systems.

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Responsible for design, development and maintenance of human resources application for recruiting.  Software is designed as an Internet-based, three-tier application under WIN 98/NT environment and is deployed via an ASP model.
•	Responsible for complete lifecycle of OOA and OOD, coding and testing.
•	Responsible for database administration, SQL tuning and performance tuning for the system. Designed and implemented relational database and SQL.  Created utilities to build, synchronize and modify different database schemas using Delphi.
•	Implemented a field-level security system for user groups.
•	Developed and implemented a unique search method to search any value for any field within the database from within the application.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for design, development and maintenance of automobile tracking system via wireless telecommunication using Delphi, Visual C++, Visual Basics, SQL server under window 95/98/NT environment.
•	Designed and implemented Process Monitoring system to monitor all the processes in the tracking system .
•	Designed and implemented OCX controls for automobile route navigation using Visual C++.
•	Modified existing OCX controls for Radio I/O telecommunication using Visual Basic.

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description:
Responsible for design and development of a Web-based online Call Detail Analysis (CDA) system to tracking all 800 number usage using Oracle, Java, Javascript, HTML, Perl, and Korn shell scripts. Also responsible for the design and implementation of the Business Result and Planning Platform (BRPP) to provide revenue summary and detail for different software using Visual Basic, Holos 4GL language and Oracle DBMS. Provided Ad-hoc on-line reporting system using UNIX shell script, Perl and AWK for tracking all the international long distance service.
•	Developed relational database designs and wrote SQL.
•	Served as Webmaster to design and maintain  the AT&T district Web page.
•	Developed utility programs for data cleaning and validation using C, Perl and AWK under UNIX
